description: FC-LAB-006: after a valid push-up, upright elbow bends must not count as additional push-ups. Inspired by historical repositioning footage; inputs are synthetic, not recovered camera landmarks.
oracle: One complete, four-second push-up counts once. After leaving the required horizontal exercise position, three upright elbow-bend cycles must leave the count at one. Counting arm motion in another posture as push-ups is a false measurement. Do not treat a failed assertion as an expected failure.

steps.label: The requested push-up movement is active
Positive control: a complete push-up counts once
Upright elbow bends cannot add push-ups after arming
Position loss does not falsely finish the set
User can still leave the interrupted set
